About Me

My Introduction

I'm Hongdao Meng, an AI Engineer based in San Jose, California. At TikTok’s GMPT Transaction Platform team, I develop Transaction Agent, focusing on high-performance knowledge bases, automated skill generation, and agent evaluation and self-improvement. My experience spans deepfake detection, RAG, recommendation infrastructure, and federated learning, with a computer science background from NYU and first-author research published in IEEE Transactions on Big Data.
